name: Trap Hole
description: Turn 1d6 of your cells into traps, which will collapse and instantly kill any monster that steps on them

name: Shield
description: Distribute 1d6 points of DEF, up to 6 per creature

name: Sword
description: Distribute 1d6 points of ATK amongst your creatures

name: Terraforming
description: All monsters with the chosen attribute or type gain +2 ATK and +1 DEF while on your tiles.
